title: HelmGuard raises $7.3m to for agentic GRC platform

title: US Bank pilots custom-built stablecoin

This milestone represents a significant step for traditional financial institutions exploring blockchain technology for cross-border payments and internal settlement processes.

title: Trezor says third-party security breach led to phishing emails from legitimate domain
summary: This follows last month's security breach at shipping provider ShipMonk, which exposed the personal information of Trezor customers.
content: Hardware wallet provider Trezor reported a third-party security breach that resulted in phishing emails being sent to customers from a legitimate domain. Security incidents of this nature often increase the risk of targeted phishing attacks against cryptocurrency users.
